title: Welsh Shepherd's Pie
description: A classic British dish made with ground lamb, vegetables, and topped with a layer of mashed potatoes. A hearty and comforting meal for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: blackberries
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen, for added sweetness

instructions: In a large pan over medium heat, cook the lamb until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for a further 5 minutes.
If using, stir in the canned pie mix. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Meanwhile, boil the chopped potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. Add the milk, butter, and mash until smooth.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish. Top with the mashed potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh blackberries if desired.
